My pieces ('O') are at 1, 4, 8.

    `X O X`
    `O O 5`
    `6 X O`

3.  Similarly, if I play `[5]`, I create a threat on the middle row, forcing them to play `[3]`.

A forcing move is competitively stronger than a passive one. By playing `[3]`, I dictate the opponent's next move and steer the game towards a guaranteed draw, leaving no room for clever plays on their part.
